judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` with status `In Progress`. Critically, using `strict: false` on the Ajv instance allows unknown keywords like `{type: 'not-a-json-schema-type'}` to pass compilation without throwing (or worse, failing to throw in the test that expects `register` to throw on an invalid type), whereas default `Ajv` (used by the reference) throws on invalid types. Furthermore, `docs/adding-a-tool.md` was modified inside a `<!-- doc-block: example/weather-tool.ts#weather-tool -->` region without updating `example/weather-tool.ts` to match, which breaks doc-block sync checks. Finally, many required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema changes per call, static compilation count, unknown tool throw) and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, as the candidate put a subset of tests into an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead.
